engineering_artifact_replay.initial_cpu_assertion: Initial CPU replay assertion at atol=1e-5/rtol=1e-4 failed for the inherited base VM. Reported backend difference above; native CUDA replay was exact for both models. New adapter CPU difference was 7.15e-7.
engineering_artifact_replay.method: Load saved final state and benchmark_data.npz, reconstruct each model, seed42, replay eval on CUDA; recompute standard metrics from saved predictions and targets.

findings.finding: Interrupted trainer bundles previously allowed remaining planned fits to continue.
findings.resolution: Runner archives interrupted bundle then stops and emits an incomplete terminal receipt.

findings.finding: Outer loop failures previously escaped without a terminal summary.
findings.resolution: Phase failure capture now finalizes retained attempts; final source verification failure marks incomplete rather than suppressing the receipt.

findings.finding: Prior phase completeness and configuration/source identities were not fully replayed before confirmation lock.
findings.resolution: Exact plan matrix, stage/config/source identities, counts, compact row identities, .pt hashes, summary equality and prescribed selections are checked; confirmation guard independently repeats these proofs.

findings.finding: Successful status alone could certify missing scientific metrics.
findings.resolution: Completion now requires finite nonnegative clean and validation errors; hardened guard also checks selected timestamp eligibility.

findings.finding: Feasibility used realized cap overshoot and omitted compact record write/progress costs.
findings.resolution: Adaptive bound now uses maximum complete block duration; nonfit timing includes compact write and progress output; actual realized overshoot is also retained.

findings.finding: New guard required interruption=false while actual successful phase writes null.
findings.resolution: Guard accepts canonical interruption=null; focused tests cover real receipt shape.

findings.finding: Full hardened verification work was not included in confirmation feasibility.
findings.resolution: Runner creates a timing-only proof, measures actual full verify_lock execution, charges all 31 entry/target invocations, and creates a final lock only if the unchanged ceiling passes. Timing-only proofs are rejected by default and by reserved generation.

limits: This review is not a formal proof or an adversarial sandbox boundary; Python source and direct generator internals remain accessible to the authorized research process.
Full repository suite and final source lock are root-owned prerequisites and were not certified by this review record.
No pilot/development/confirmation scientific artifacts existed during this implementation review; no claim about their future completeness or scientific benefit is made.
Engineering benchmark acceptance certifies the fixed adapter integration only, not scalar-arm superiority or forecasting usefulness.
A filesystem write failure can prevent an attempted artifact from being written; retained plan/terminal failure identifies incomplete work and never permits confirmation.
Phase wall timing includes final summary serialization and hashing; terminal receipt serialization occurs immediately after its elapsed-time timestamp.
positive_checks: Exact prospective matrices enumerate 75 pilot, 220 development and 1320 confirmation fits.
Reserved generation calls default verify_lock before RNG or target construction; preflight timing proofs cannot authorize it.
Model selection occurs only in development and learning-rate selection only in pilot; confirmation carries locked choices.
Every declared model and allowance is retained, including failed and late-checkpoint outcomes.
Adapter source manifest and source snapshot include src/smooth_local_v1.py via src/*.py.
reviewer_role: Forecaster subagent; independent of root protocol/runner authorship. Authored the adapter, so its implementation is not represented as independently reviewed here.
scope: Read-only protocol/runner review against frozen VM-N01 contract, final defect recheck, guard tests and saved engineering artifact replay. No study target generation or scientific fitting.

validation.scope: Independent rerun after final guard and preflight changes
Adapter-author focused tests before actual benchmark; includes CUDA output and gradient parity
